question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

WHO is __an organisation that raises money for a particular cause__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fundraiser**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **fundraiser **is a person or an event that raises funds for a particular cause or organization. (अनुदान संचय)

 
 
• **Example**: *We organized a successful fundraiser to support the local community centre.*
 
 
 
• The word "fundraiser" can be used as a noun to refer to the person or event that raises funds.
 
• The word is formed by combining "fund" (money set aside for a specific purpose) and "raiser" (someone or something that raises or lifts up).
 
• In the given sentence, "**WHO**" is an organization that raises money for a particular cause, so the best one-word substitute for this group of words is "**fundraiser**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Donation **refers to the act of giving money or other resources to a person or organization in need. (दान)
 
• **Volunteer** refers to a person who offers their time and services for free to help others or a particular cause. (स्वयंसेवक)
 
• **Charity **refers to the practice of giving money, goods, or services to those in need or to organizations that help others. (परोपकार)
